fields.errorDenominatorRule: errorMaxAbs = max_{t,i} |y_num,i(t) - y_exact,i(t)| over 20001 ode45 dense-output points on t=[0,2*pi], y_exact=[cos(t); -sin(t)]. errorMaxScaled = max_{t,i} |err_i(t)| / ||y_exact(t)||_inf, denominator = solution magnitude max(|cos t|,|sin t|) at the same t (>= sqrt(2)/2, never zero); the component-wise rule |err_i|/|y_exact_i| was rejected because both components pass through zero where it is unbounded. errorSolverMaxScaled = max_{t,i} |err_i(t)| / (AbsTol + RelTol*|y_exact_i(t)|), the global error in units of the solver's own elementwise error-control envelope (RelTol=1e-8, AbsTol=1e-10); it exceeds 1 only for the component crossing zero at t=2*pi (|y_exact|=2.4e-16, so only the AbsTol floor 1e-10 is in the denominator); with ||y_exact||_inf in the envelope instead it is 4.711961e-01. invariantMaxRelDrift = max_t |y1(t)^2 + y2(t)^2 - 1| / |y1(0)^2 + y2(0)^2|.
